decks.notes: This aggro deck focuses on assembling a diverse range of powerful creatures and utilizing cards like Birthing Ritual and Leyline Binding to quickly generate mana and control the board. With cards like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Omnath, Locus of Creation at its disposal, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of creature-based aggression and potent spellcasting. The inclusion of disruptive elements like Subtlety and Force of Negation helps to protect the deck's key threats and maintain its aggressive tempo.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Broodscale Bloodchief archetype in combination with Eldrazi creatures and support cards to create a powerful combo that can overwhelm the opponent quickly. By utilizing cards like Basking Broodscale, Emrakul, the Promised End, and Malevolent Rumble, the deck aims to control the board and establish dominance through various synergies and powerful interactions. The inclusion of additional support cards such as Ancient Stirrings, Kozilek's Command, and Ugin's Labyrinth helps to further enhance the deck's strategy and overall effectiveness in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to quickly deploy aggressive creatures like Nethergoyf, Emperor of Bones, and Orcish Bowmasters, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Kozilek's Command. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells such as Fatal Push, while also utilizing hand disruption and card advantage to maintain pressure. Additionally, with the versatile Urza's Saga and mana acceleration from cards like Eldrazi Temple, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling a wide range of creature options through creature tutoring and recursion, supported by a variety of combo pieces and removal spells. The goal is to generate value through creature interactions and disrupt the opponent's strategy while building towards a game-winning combo finish utilizing Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and other key creatures. The deck aims to be resilient and adaptable, able to adjust its game plan based on the opponent's actions while maintaining pressure and presenting threats.

This deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy, utilizing a combination of powerful creatures and burn spells to apply early pressure and overwhelm the opponent. By playing efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, along with versatile cards like Quantum Riddler and Leyline of the Guildpact, the deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize. With access to a wide range of colors thanks to cards like Tribal Flames and Leyline Binding, this deck can adapt to different situations and maintain a strong offensive presence throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the aggro strategy by quickly filling up the graveyard with cards like Street Wraith, Blazing Rootwalla, and Burning Inquiry, to then bring back powerful creatures like Vengevine and Hollow One. The deck also has strong removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Marauding Mako to control the board. Detective's Phoenix and Hardened Academic provide additional value by recurring creatures or drawing cards. The mana base is built to consistently cast spells and quickly assemble the necessary cards to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on using instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance to bring powerful creatures like Griselbrand back from the graveyard for a game-winning combo. It also utilizes cards like Ephemerate and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to protect its combo pieces and control the board. The deck has a mix of control elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation, along with card draw and filtering options like Faithful Mending and Quantum Riddler. Overall, the strategy is to quickly reanimate key creatures and overwhelm the opponent with powerful combos.

The deck revolves around using instant speed reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to bring back powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Emperor of Bones from the graveyard. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and control the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly assemble its key pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence. Additionally, it includes a mix of lands and utility spells to support the combo and ensure consistency in its execution.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt and control your opponent's hand and board while fueling your own graveyard. The deck utilizes discard spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt your opponent's plans, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Witherbloom Charm to deal with threats. Necrodominance and Soul Spike allow you to take advantage of your graveyard, while cards like March of Wretched Sorrow and Boggart Trawler help you generate value from your graveyard. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast your opponent through control and graveyard synergy.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifacts with cards like Mox Amber and Mox Opal to power out threats like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The goal is to control the board with cards like Fatal Push and Force of Negation while also generating card advantage with Mishra's Bauble and Nihil Spellbomb. The deck also features disruptive creatures like Basim Ibn Ishaq and Erayo, Soratami Ascendant to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption.

The primary focus of this deck is to utilize powerful control elements such as Dress Down, Force of Negation, and Mana Leak to disrupt and control the opponent's strategies. In addition, the deck aims to assemble the UrzaTron (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate massive amounts of mana for playing big threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ugin, the Eye of the Storms. With a mix of control elements and powerful late-game threats, this deck aims to outlast and outvalue opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 setting.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategies and control the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Force of Negation and Counterspell, while also using cards like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict to deal with threats. The deck includes powerful finishers like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Murktide Regent to close out the game. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Quantum Riddler to generate card advantage and outvalue the opponent.

This aggressive Modern deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards like Vengevine, Blazing Rootwalla, and Detective's Phoenix to bring them back into play for free. Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting help to fuel this strategy, while Hollow One provides additional threats. Lightning Bolt offers direct removal and Practiced Offense boosts the team's power. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient creature-based strategy, utilizing the graveyard as a resource to constantly pressure the opponent.

This deck focuses on assembling creatures and supporting cards to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The main strategy involves utilizing key cards like Basking Broodscale and Emrakul, the Promised End in combination with various Eldrazi and support spells to generate a deadly board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By efficiently ramping up mana, controlling the board, and maximizing the effectiveness of combo pieces, this deck aims to quickly establish dominance and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan using a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures. The deck aims to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing for the casting of powerful threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. By utilizing control elements such as Spell Snare, Force of Negation, and Subtlety, the deck looks to stabilize the board and outvalue the opponent in the late game.

The deck is focused on quickly building a board presence using cheap artifacts and creature spells, then using various utility cards to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect its own threats. With a good mix of card draw, creature recursion, and mana acceleration, it aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient resource management. It relies heavily on artifacts and synergy between cards to create a fast and powerful game plan that can close out matches before the opponent has a chance to recover.
